source: LuxAlgo MACD Based Price Forecasting [Pine Script v5] — adapted to Python
description: Builds memory of historical price changes during MACD uptrend (MACD>Signal) and downtrend (MACD<Signal) phases. Uses percentile distributions (P50 for TP, P20 for SL) to project targets when a new phase begins. Only signals in early bars of a fresh phase transition.
entry_conditions: New MACD phase transition (crossover/crossunder) within last 5 bars
Minimum 8 completed historical phases per direction
Projected R:R >= 1.5 based on phase percentile distributions
Historical phase direction consistency (win rate check)

exit_conditions.take_profit: P50 of same-direction historical phase moves
exit_conditions.stop_loss: P20 of adverse-direction historical phase moves OR 1.5x ATR (tighter)

expected_regime: trending — performs best when MACD phases have consistent directional moves
academic_reference: Gerald Appel (1979) MACD; LuxAlgo MACD Price Forecasting methodology
